errors.text: The proposed ordered-compound ML model with an empirical lattice-distortion correction is fundamentally different from the target liquid-phase MTP plus free-energy-perturbation methodology.
The hypothesis retains modified thermodynamic integration rather than replacing expensive TI with rapidly convergent FEP.
The cited evidence concerns mechanical deformation and irradiation resistance, not melting free energies, entropy of fusion, heat capacity, MTP accuracy, or a δ/VEC correction.
The lattice-distortion correction factor and claimed <5% accuracy are asserted without a mathematical definition, calibration data, or relevant validation evidence.
Key target physics—electronic Gibbs-energy contributions, density-of-states effects near the Fermi level, solid-state short-range order, and low-variance MTP-to-DFT energy differences—is absent.
